title: Renovation, operation & maintenance of a carousel, snack bar & family amusement venue at Forest Park & the renovation, operation & maintenance of the carousel, mobile food & souvenir units,& children's amusement rides at Flushing Meadows Corona Park
agency_path: City of New York > Parks and Recreation
description_text:
In accordance with Section 1-13 of the Concession Rules of the City of New York, the New York City Department of Parks and Recreation (Parks) intends to issue a significant Request for Proposals (RFP) for the renovation, operation and maintenance of a carousel, snack bar and family amusement venue at Forest Park and the renovation, operation and maintenance of the carousel, mobile food and souvenir units, and children's amusement rides at Flushing Meadows Corona Park.

There will be a recommended remote proposer meeting on Monday, October 5, 2026, at 12:00 pm. If you are considering responding to this RFP, please make every effort to attend this recommended remote proposer meeting.

 

The link for the remote proposer meeting is as follows:

https://teams.microsoft.com/meet/258280651139195?p=p30Anw512xCi7R6J8w 

Meeting ID: 258 280 651 139 195

Passcode: eg6iW3Yt

You may also join the remote proper meeting by phone using the following information:

+1 646-893-7101,,773197702# United States, New York City

Phone conference ID: 773 197 702#

Subject to availability and by appointment only, we may set up a meeting at the proposed concession sites, Forest Park and Flushing Meadows Corona Park. (Licensed Premises).

All proposals submitted in response to this RFP must be submitted no later than Friday, October 30, 2026, at 3:00 p.m.

Hard copies of the RFP can be obtained at no cost, by contacting Luiggi Almanzar, Project Manager at (212)360-3483 or at luiggi.almanzar@parks.nyc.gov, commencing Monday, September 28, 2026, through October 30, 2026, between the hours of 9:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m., excluding weekends and Holidays, at the Concessions Division of the New York City Department of Parks and Recreation, which is located at 830 Fifth Avenue, Room 407, New York, NY 10065.

The RFP is also available for download, commencing Monday, September 28, 2026, through October 30, 2026, on Parks website. To download the RFP, visit  http://www.nyc.gov/parks/businessopportunities and click on the Concessions Opportunities at Parks link. Once you have logged in, click on the download link that appears adjacent to the RFPs description.

For more information or if you cannot attend the remote proposer meeting, prospective proposers may contact Luiggi Almanzar, Project Manager at (212)360-3483 or at luiggi.almanzar@parks.nyc.gov.
